project_type: Flutter + Supabase household app (Spanish, 'PrezHome'), cozy design system, non-technical end user
build_system: Flutter SDK at ~/flutter_sdk (pinned branch 3.47.6, Dart 3.13.5, pubspec SDK ^3.11.1). Use PATH export; dart format uses tall style.
test_framework: flutter_test, pure-logic unit tests in test/ (e.g. task_schedule_test.dart, task_occurrences_test.dart). Baseline main = 201 tests passing.
build_command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter pub get (then git checkout -- autogenerated files)
test_command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter test
verification_instructions: Reproduce CI EXACTLY (note the trailing DOT): 1) dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .  -> 0 changed; 2) flutter analyze -> 'No issues found!'; 3) flutter test -> all green (>=201); 4) dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check -> OK (if it fails, regenerate with 'dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart' and commit docs/architecture/dependency-map.md). After flutter pub get, discard autogenerated changes with 'git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml' and any linux/macos/windows plugin registrants / .flutter-plugins-dependencies.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/architecture/dependency-map.md is generated by 'dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart' and validated in CI with --check. Regenerate and commit if the guard fails. pubspec.lock / analysis_options.yaml / plugin registrants are modified by 'flutter pub get' and MUST be discarded with git checkout --.
setup_instructions: If ~/flutter_sdk missing: git clone --depth 1 --branch 3.47.6 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git ~/flutter_sdk . Then export PATH and FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS, run flutter pub get. (SDK is already present in this sandbox.)
environment_constraints: Sandbox has Flutter SDK pre-cloned at ~/flutter_sdk. No Supabase/Docker: migrations are validated STATICALLY by CI (filename NNNN_nombre.sql with 4 digits, balanced parentheses ignoring '--' comments, content ends with ';'). The 'validacion de cambios IA / revision manual' workflow FAILS ON PURPOSE when a migration touches policies/RLS; this is EXPECTED and does not block merge. Do NOT run the app against a live DB.
contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/security.md: every user-data table has home_id + RLS keyed on public.auth_home_id(); client never writes control fields; control-sensitive changes (like deducting a verifiable balance) should go through SECURITY DEFINER RPC with fixed search_path. Follow .kiro/steering/design-system.md implicitly via existing tokens: NO visible 'IA'/'AI' text, radius 16 (AppRadius.md) / cards use AppTheme.cardDecoration/surfaceDecoration, theme tokens only (AppColors incl. inkMuted, AppSpacing, AppRadius, AppElevation, AppTextStyles, AppMotion). Motion via existing utilities: PressScale, AnimatedCounter, Celebrate.show(context), respecting reduce-motion. Spanish cozy copy, Miau empty states.
key_patterns: Migrations are idempotent (create table if not exists, add column if not exists, drop policy if exists + create policy). RLS pattern: 'for select using (home_id = public.auth_home_id())', insert 'with check (home_id = public.auth_home_id())', task_points insert additionally checks 'user_id = auth.uid()'. Grants: 'grant select,insert,update,delete on <table> to authenticated'. Screens load home_id from profiles, then query by home_id (RLS enforced). TaskScheduler.complete(task) inserts task_points {home_id,user_id,points,task_id} then reschedules. HomeTask.fromMap is null-tolerant with sensible defaults. Pool semantics = assigned_to IS NULL. Last migration is 0041 -> create 0042.
